policy.purpose: CI-accessible research calibration only; not production market data.
policy.identity_freeze: Carney identity rules are never fitted to outcome statistics.
policy.forming_holdout: Forming-signal Holdout outcomes stay sealed until a quality policy is explicitly frozen.
policy.completed_reaction_holdout: Completed-reaction Holdout outcomes stay sealed; only identity metadata and counts may be emitted.
policy.completed_reaction_sample_floor: 60 actionable completed reactions with 30/10/10 post-purge train/validation/holdout floors are an HT-CN research-governance policy, not a Carney rule or statistical guarantee.
policy.metadata_only: name and bucket are descriptive metadata and are not model features.
